channel.title: Pier & Point · Potrero Power Station Block 8
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Potrero Power Station Block 8 (Potrero Power Station), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 8: Potrero Block 8's shape log no longer claims the lot lines sit on block edges where the trace was a few metres off.
item.description: Potrero Block 8's shape log no longer claims the lot lines sit on block edges where the trace was a few metres off. Source: Pier & Point's comparison of the traced outline with DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn).

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 8: Potrero Power Station Block 8 now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Potrero Power Station Block 8 now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 4232022.

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 8: Block 8's map notes now say Figure 6.2.3 gives it 125 ft and 85 ft limits and that the '90' MAX' labels are dimension lines, not a 90 ft height. The parcel note no longer says the block has no address: DataSF Parcels lists an active lot at 151 Humboldt St (4232022), the address the Chronicle gives for the building, that lies almost entirely within the footprint (whether to switch the map to it is undecided). The D4D transit facilities are corrected (a shuttle stop and shelter on Block 8; the bus stop and operator restroom are on Block 12), the rental and developer-rename wording is tied to sources, the YA Studio partnership is described as a March 2022 stated intention, and the 2028 completion is shown as a stale phase forecast from SocketSite's October 2020 schedule and SF YIMBY (2021), not a record-based date. The Foster + Partners rendering is no longer hosted here because the sheet is marked (c) Foster + Partners and the state permission page does not cover third-party copying; the Design Review Approval stays linked. Sources and one image label were also corrected.

item.title: Expected · Potrero Power Station Block 8: Completion expected: SocketSite's October 2020 revised-phasing schedule lists Block 8 vertical development 2026-2028 (Phase 1) and SF YIMBY's March 2021 report anticipated completion in 2028; the August 2026 report of JPMorgan construction financing and a fall 2026 start gives no completion date, and no source since 2021 restates a 2028 completion (~2028)
